rework_history: The cache replay fixture referenced command-observation authority without materializing the exact receipt.
Root widened the lease to two stale test-only command fixtures after the dependency suite exposed them.
The first line-cap refusal test opportunistically launched the current lib-test executable on a fresh target and observed exit 101 instead of the intended typed public refusal.

The accepted correction performs direct replay rejection and production parser calls under panic containment, proving exact CLI_UNKNOWN_SUBCOMMAND exit class 2 without discovering or launching a guessed executable.

diagnostic_classification.signal: detects_concurrent_candidate_mutation reported as a passing leaky test

closed_findings: Cache replay accepts only an exact materialized external command-observation receipt and rejects missing, inline, unsafe, mismatched, stale, post-binding-mutated, or semantically substituted authority.
The legacy line-cap summary cannot become successor command replay authority and the production parser rejects the retired route with stable typed exit class 2, no echo, no panic, and no cache hit.
Cargo-provided fresh binaries classify clean, dirty, conflicting-authority, failed-diagnosis, repair, next, repeat-read, stream, and exit-class fixtures.
Help, version, malformed parse, inspect, capabilities, inventory, state, claims, next, diagnose, and observe query preserve recursive type, bytes, permissions, and Git porcelain at the tested scope.
Machine stdout and stderr remain separated, versioned, bounded, non-echoing, and fail closed.
ceiling_correction: The WorkerResult mentions link-count comparison, but its snapshots do not record link count. Accepted zero-write proof is limited to recursive entry type, bytes, permissions, and Git status equality.
